dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned review text feeds lexicon sentiment scoring.
Cleaned votes, ratings, text and identity fields feed PCA.
Three components and review age feed CS and COM_S.
Monthly ratings, sentiment, review counts and helpful votes feed ARIMA.
Star events and before/after responses feed non-parametric tests.
Review sentiment and dates feed time-weighted interaction variables.
COM_S enters the extreme-review cluster profile.
Special-star results condition the extreme-attitude interpretation.
Weighted next-review variables support event and cluster analysis.
Descriptive product contrasts feed feature priorities.
COM_S rankings feed better/worse product lists.
Short forecasts feed dated manager advice.
Extreme-review associations feed risk caveats in the letter.
